text:
Kevin W: Quick design thought — want to introduce project-bound API keys that carry project_id and a routing_hint. Goal: let edge routing and quota systems make decisions without proxying to org-level lookups.

Maria S: +1 on reducing lookups. Do we plan to make project_id required on all keys?

Kevin W: Proposal: new key type 'project_key' optional for now. If absent, fallback to current org/project resolution. If present, header x-project-id must match key scope.

Raj P: How does this affect quota attribution? We currently attribute by org->project inferred path. If the key has an explicit project, we can short-circuit attribution and avoid the extra join.

Emily C: Telemetry folks: we'll need new metrics and tags. Suggest: auth.project_key.bind_count, routing.hint_used=true/false, quota.attribution_source=[key, inferred]. Also add a boolean tag project_key=true when present.

Dmitri K: UX question: console needs a place to create project-scoped keys and show drift. We should surface "exported routing_hint" field and a warning: "changing project binding invalidates cached attributions for 24h".

Maria S: For rollout, do a beta: opt-in per org + feature flag. Start with internal+alpha orgs, then customer opt-ins.

Kevin W: Implementation plan: runtime accepts key with embedded metadata (project_id, routing_hint). If routing_hint present, runtime routes to dedicated pool or model variant based on policy. Fallback chain: key->project->org.

Raj P: Edge case: service accounts used across multiple projects. We need to allow multi-project binding or scoped impersonation. Otherwise platform teams will object.

Emily C: Ops: add a histogram for time-to-attribution and a counter for 'attribution_fallback' so we can detect regressions. Also add an alert when >1% requests use fallback for 5m.

Dmitri K: Console wire: create a small flow: Create key -> choose scope (org / project / multi-project) -> routing hint (optional) -> preview effective quotas and SLOs. Keep it 2-step.

Kevin W: Migration: legacy keys default to inferred behavior. We'll add a migration job to annotate keys for active projects based on recent usage (opt-in). But require admin consent.

Maria S: Security: ensure signing verification still matches. If we embed project_id in token claims, it must be validated against key metadata. Reject mismatches with 401.

deploy-bot: build/infra-ci started for branch feat/project-keys (job #4821) :gear:

Raj P: One more: update billing exports to include "key_scope" column so cost breakdowns align with routing.

Emily C: Timeline suggestion: 2 weeks for runtime + telemetry hooks, 1 week console mockups + 1 week rollout canary and test orgs.

Kevin W: Sounds good. Open questions: how to represent multi-project keys in quota engine, and whether routing_hint should be free text or limited enum (region/pool).

Maria S: My vote: routing_hint is enum for now (region|gpu_pool|latency_tier). We can add free text later.

Dmitri K: I'll mock wire frames by EOD tomorrow and add to the feature PR.

Kevin W: OK. Action items: @Dmitri mock console, @Emily add telemetry + alerts, @Raj spec quota changes, @Maria own rollout plan + admin migration consent, I'll drive the runtime patch.

Maria S: Nice. If anyone wants to be on the beta list ping me. :thumbsup:
